capabilities: Render ```button code blocks as buttons in Reading view and Live Preview
Open web, email and Obsidian links
Insert, prepend or copy text at chosen lines or into new notes
Chain several actions in one button
disambiguation: Not a toolbar or ribbon button builder; it renders ```button code blocks inside notes.
extras: Core features are free; Pro (template buttons, calculate buttons, vault-wide button check) needs a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of $5 a month or $15 once, and works offline for up to 14 days after a successful check. Inline buttons show in Reading view only; buttons on a canvas and Templater commands are not supported.
intentEvidence: Your ```button blocks keep working, because Button Blocks reads the Buttons syntax as it is.
